summary: Clear per-app correction evidence when privacy tightens

changes.title: Reset per-app correction evidence at privacy boundaries
changes.detail: Clear the bounded, content-free rejection counter whenever the active editor is ineligible for transient correction memory, including settings reloads and keyboard-session starts. This prevents partial confirmation counts from carrying across a private or no-learning context. Only verified host-confirmed correction reversals remain eligible; profile thresholds, encrypted storage, and explicit user settings are unchanged.
